# Super Job Agent — Deep Technical Audit, Competitor Gap Analysis & Implementation Roadmap

Audit date: 2026-06-23 (Asia/Calcutta)  
Repository path: `/home/user/project/super-job-agent`

## 1. Executive Summary

Super Job Agent is a TypeScript monorepo for local-first job matching, browser-extension autofill, headless Playwright applying, job scraping, email-based application tracking, and a small multi-agent crew workflow. The product direction is strong: it combines Simplify-style autofill, Jobright-style matching, Teal/Huntr-style tracking, and LoopCV/Sonara-style automation while keeping data local.

**Current readiness after fixes applied in this workspace:**

- ✅ `npm run typecheck` passes across all workspaces.
- ✅ Core tests pass: 91 assertions.
- ✅ Extension autofill integration passes: 14 assertions.
- ✅ Crew integration passes: 16 assertions.
- ✅ Email monitor integration passes: 23 assertions.
- ✅ Scraper integration passes: 11 assertions.
- ✅ Chrome MV3 extension builds successfully: `.output/chrome-mv3`, ~868 KB.
- ⚠️ Full Playwright applier integration cannot run in this sandbox because Chromium is missing system library `libnspr4.so`; this is environment-specific, not necessarily product code failure.
- ⚠️ `npm audit` still reports 10 dev/build-chain vulnerabilities mainly through `wxt -> web-ext-run/fx-runner/giget/tar/tmp`. Upgrading WXT to `0.20.26` broke `wxt/sandbox` export compatibility in this repo, so this needs a planned migration rather than a blind force update.
